hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf|--force|git\s+push.*-f|git\s+reset.*--hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected. Please confirm with user first.' && exit 2; fi
for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [[ "$f" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done
